{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking fresh ideas across projects and teams.

## Format
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier.
- **Title**: Short descriptive title.
- **Description**: Detailed explanation.
- **Originator**: Who suggested the idea.
- **Date Added**: When the idea was recorded.
- **Status**: New / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Notes**: Additional comments or follow‑up actions.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file.
2. Append a new entry following the format above.
3. Save the file.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI‑Powered Chatbot
Description: Develop a chatbot that uses GPT‑4 to answer customer queries.
Originator: Jane Doe
Date Added: 2026‑07‑16
Status: New
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```
